title: New aircraft gets audit and version defaults
why: Shows that the system fills in the identity and audit fields, not the caller.

steps.does: POST …/flight/aircraft with Name 'Audit Check Jet', Model '737-800', ManufacturingYear 2018, then read back the saved aircraft

expect: Id is set (non-empty GUID), Version is 0 or 1, IsDeleted is false, and CreatedAt is set to the current time.
